description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldParent, which extends SugarFieldRelate. It provides methods for rendering detail, edit, and search views of a 'Parent' relating field in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, handles import sanitization for related modules, generates quick search code, and manages search input processing.

classes.name: SugarFieldParent
classes.description: A class that manages display and handling of parent related fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM views, including detail, edit, and search views, along with import sanitization and quick search code generation.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates the Smarty template output for the detail view of the parent relationship field, toggling link display based on module type.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data and generates the Smarty template for editing the parent relationship field, including popup request data and access controls.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data and generates the Smarty template for searching by the parent relationship field.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and loads related bean information during import based on vardef type.

methods.name: createQuickSearchCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for the quick search feature related to the parent field.

methods.name: getSearchInput
methods.description: Returns the search input value for the parent field based on provided arguments and search form tab context.
